title: Smooth Surrogate Models Approve Impossible Firing Patterns: A Hidden Flaw in Writing Brain Codes (code and data)
description: Code, figures, and data for the preprint. A smooth differentiable surrogate of a Hodgkin-Huxley neuron's firing-rate (f-I) curve silently certifies target firing rates the real neuron cannot produce (the Type-II onset gap and depolarization block); the failure is invariant to fit quality, and a feasibility screen against the true f-I removes it.
